scope: Approved indicative Dinacharya for the 8 one-therapy views: Preventive Health & Regenerative, Digestive Wellness, Yoga & Meditation and Yoga based Stress & Energy Reset (desktop/mobile). One 09:30 therapy, 15:30 personal time; 17:00 gentle practice only on the two Yoga programmes. Corrects the conflicting "Daily 2 Therapies" icon label on the 6 Digestive/Yoga views. Explicit files only; no auto.
